notes.about: Devanagari as the engine has always read it for Hindi. These rules were code (engine/core/src/script/deva.rs) until they became this file; the engine also carries a copy for a deva pack that has no lang file. hi.fst is built by `lexbuild --lang` from data/lang/hi.conf with these same rules, not by lexbuild-native, so the builder's keys (firstLetter, signs, maxWords, minCount) are not here.
notes.block: Devanagari, U+0900-U+097F. A word is a run of its letters and signs, virama and nukta included.
notes.notWord: The danda and double danda, the digits ०-९ and the abbreviation sign ॰ (U+0964-U+0970) are not letters.
notes.bases: A vowel sign can follow a consonant क-ह, a precomposed nukta letter (U+0958-U+095F: NFC decomposes them, but text may still hold one), the extra consonants at the end of the block, and a nukta after any of those.
notes.replace: None. The normal form is the engine's own: NFC (ज़ U+095B becomes ज + nukta, while ऩ ऱ ऴ stay single code points), ’ to ', and every ZWJ and ZWNJ dropped.
notes.phraseBreaks: The danda । and double danda ॥ end a phrase; next-word pairs never span one.
